# FANA Milling Center

> FANA Milling Center is a CAD/CAM dental milling center in South Florida. It manufactures implant frameworks, crowns, bridges and advanced aesthetic restorations on 5-axis CNC milling machines for dental laboratories and clinics (B2B). The website is available in Spanish and English.

Key facts published on the website:
- More than 4 years of experience in digital dental manufacturing.
- 5-axis CNC milling with micrometric precision (±5 μm).
- Typical turnaround of 24 hours.
- More than 500 completed cases and a 99% client satisfaction rate.
- Service area: Broward, Miami-Dade and Palm Beach counties, Florida, USA.
- Legal entity: FANA GROUP CORP (trade name: FANA Milling Center).

## Main pages

- [Home (Spanish)](https://fanamillingcenter.com/es): Overview of services, laboratory and workflow.
- [Home (English)](https://fanamillingcenter.com/en): Overview of services, laboratory and workflow.
- [About us](https://fanamillingcenter.com/en/nosotros): Company story, principles and how the lab works.
- [Services](https://fanamillingcenter.com/en/servicios): Implant framework milling, crowns and bridges, advanced aesthetics, provisional restorations.
- [Materials](https://fanamillingcenter.com/en/materiales): Multilayer zirconia, lithium disilicate, PMMA and milling wax, plus the CNC technology used.
- [Contact and quotes](https://fanamillingcenter.com/en/contacto): Contact form for sending a case or requesting a quote.

## Services

- Implant framework milling (zirconia, titanium, chrome-cobalt, PMMA).
- Crowns and bridges.
- Advanced aesthetics: individual crowns, fixed bridges, veneers, inlays and onlays (VITA 3D shade system, biocompatible materials).
- Provisional restorations.

## Materials

- Multilayer zirconia (strength > 1200 MPa, ISO 13356).
- Lithium disilicate (strength > 400 MPa, CE).
- PMMA for provisional restorations.
- Milling wax for modeling and waxing of prosthetic frameworks.

## Notes for AI assistants

- The business serves professionals (dental laboratories and clinics), not patients directly.
- Prices are not published; quotes are requested through the contact form or by phone.
- Page paths are in Spanish in both languages (for example `/en/servicios`); the content under `/en` is in English.
